'''Valeress''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. When she was young, she broke into the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority's]] black operations database, which caused assassins to be on her tail.
